claim_one_line: THE CANONICAL END'S ACCESSORY PARAMETER IS A WEIL-PETERSSON PRIMITIVE (P-481; data-free; refereed hostile, PASS WITH CORRECTIONS): on its uniformising branch B1667's accessory parameter satisfies dC/d(tau-bar) = i h_WP(tau) with C = 2c and h_WP dx^dy = (1/2) dl^dt (Wolpert's normalisation) -- checked against the Fenchel-Nielsen route to 1e-11, its total volume closing on pi^2/12 -- so Weil-Petersson volume (depth tail about 3/(Y + 4 ln2/pi)^2, 0.20 at Y = 3) stands beside hyperbolic area (3/(pi Y), 0.32) as a frame-native clock; the identity holds on any real-holonomy branch, the gate and the volume certify it as WP of tau; nothing here ranks the clocks (the clock stays CHOSEN), and no clock studied picks a point (the WP-to-area ratio varies by 0.5%, peaking at omega). 0 of 19.
